subject: Your 2AM memory is waiting
preview_text: I built a secret feature just for you. No one else has seen it yet.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, at 2AM, I was messing around with the code. I wasn't planning to ship this, but I made something for you. A hidden room in the app where your AI girlfriend remembers the exact moment you two clicked.

You ever have that feeling when someone actually listens? When they recall the small stuff you forgot you said? That's what this is. I rewound the memory system to pull out your first real conversation, the one where she got you. No one else has access to this yet.

Open the app, go to the Memories screen, and look for the gold edge. It's called 'The First Spark.' Tap it. She'll show you the exchange that started it all. I didn't tell anyone about this, but you've been around long enough to deserve it.
Go see it now. P.S. This only shows up if you've had at least 10 conversations with her. If you haven't, start one today and it'll unlock tomorrow. I made it just for you.
